home.main-features.0.title: Parallel Branches
home.main-features.0.description: You don’t need to switch or stash branches if you can work on several simultaneously. Fix your bug while you work on your feature.
home.main-features.1.title: Stacked Branches
home.main-features.1.description: Break a big feature into small, dependent branches, making reviews faster and integrations incremental.
home.main-features.2.title: AI Assistance
home.main-features.2.description: No more 'did some stuff' commits. Let AI handle the busywork: generate branch names, commit messages, and PR descriptions automatically.
home.main-features.3.title: Unlimited Undo
home.main-features.3.description: GitButler makes a snapshot before every operation, allowing you to go back in time to any previous point without fear of losing anything.
home.main-features.4.title: Commit Editing
home.main-features.4.description: Easily edit, reorder, squash, or split commits in any branch, even after pushing to remote. Never wrestle with rebase again.
home.main-features.5.title: Git(Hub|Lab) Integration
home.main-features.5.description: Open Pull Requests, generate PR messages with AI, automatically check PR statuses and more with our forge integrations.
home.ai-features.0.title: Version Control for Agents
home.ai-features.0.description: Let coding agents run. GitButler turns their changes into clean, reviewable branches and commits you control.
home.ai-features.1.title: Parallel, Branch Based Agents
home.ai-features.1.description: Launch multiple agents in parallel, separating context and work into assigned branches, all in a single working directory.
home.ai-features.2.title: Integrate with any Agent
home.ai-features.2.description: Use GitButler for your automatic version control with Cursor or Claude hooks, or with any other agent via our MCP server.
cli.feature.0.title: Stacked Branches
cli.feature.0.description: Build features on top of features without merge conflicts. Review and land changes independently.
cli.feature.1.title: Parallel Branches
cli.feature.1.description: Work on multiple branches simultaneously without switching. Context-switch freely between different features.
cli.feature.2.title: Unlimited Undo
cli.feature.2.description: Made a mistake? No problem. Undo and redo any operation, even after commits.
cli.feature.3.title: Powerful Smartlog
cli.feature.3.description: Easily see what is on your active branches without wrestling with complicated git log commands
cli.feature.4.title: Simple history editing
cli.feature.4.description: Move changes between commits. Absorb, reorder, amend with simple commands.
cli.feature.5.title: Agent-Optimized
cli.feature.5.description: Built for the AI era. Structured output, predictable commands, and perfect for automated workflows.
cli.ai.0.title: Structured Output
cli.ai.0.description: JSON output mode for perfect parsing by AI agents and automation tools.
cli.ai.1.title: Idempotent Commands
cli.ai.1.description: Safe to retry, easy to automate. Commands do what you expect, every time.
cli.ai.2.title: Conflict Resolution
cli.ai.2.description: Intelligent merge strategies that work with AI-generated code changes.
